w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Focus Group, Static, The Callback, tick, The Focus Group) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: A frame of it hangs in the air. Then another. It's buffering.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Ad Break: Look away when the break runs. Every fourth round it runs the break — repositions, knits itself back together, and WATCHES you watch. Look away. The ad’s power is that you watch; unwatched, the break is just dead air and the healing never lands. (Ethan lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 3 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Mushrooms thumb up through the duff in a ring — a fairy ring, old as the path. You step around it, not through it. Some rules are older than knowledge.
Something moves out there — The Rerun.
👁️ Henrique freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Sign — a bobcat, tufted ears, watching you with yellow eyes passed here recently. Fresh prints. Close, maybe.

w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to creek.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Henrique freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Movement — a small fish flashing in the water.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Sanne telling Feng about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🗣️ Lizelle to Feng, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 10,996 of 14,000 kcal."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Goji Berry. Goji. Small red berries on a thorny shrub. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Naming things. Very human. The audience approves.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 4 tiles south-west caught a Gray Squirrel! — set it, waited, and the old way worked. About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.
The Snare broke. You'll need another.

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 2,605 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 114 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/10/5), with 5 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 10 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Zoe Adams ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
